messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@sunrise-analytics.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@sunrise-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed 4-week POC onramp plan for Sunrise Analytics

Hi Sarah / Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap from our side and a concrete onramp proposal so your team can review and confirm next steps. I captured what we heard and proposed owners/timing below.

1) Goal / success criteria (confirmed on call)
- Achieve >= 85% intent extraction accuracy on your 10k historical support tickets for the top-5 intents.
- Average inference latency <= 200ms p50 for 512-token requests under 10 rps.
- End-to-end demo of live agent assist with context window preserved across messages (sample flow).

2) Proposed 4-week POC (high level)
Week 0 (prep, 3 business days): access + data checklist, test dataset export, NDA/contract signatures
Week 1 (ingest & baseline): small data ingest (5k rows), baseline model runs, initial metrics
Week 2 (optimization): batching/caching profile, latency tuning, token cost projections
Week 3 (validation & handover): final eval on holdout set, runbook handoff, exec review

3) Owners & asks
- Data ingestion and baseline: Sunrise — Daniel (deliver sample export by Mon 4/2).
- POC engineering and tuning: Redwood — Mateo + Ben (setup GPU pool, config tuning).
- Security & contracts: Sunrise legal + Redwood CS (see attached data-contract-outline.docx).
- Success review and decision: Sunrise PO — Sarah (goal: sign-off or extension request).

4) Logistics / environment
- We propose using a short-lived dedicated namespace in Redwood Dedicated (shared staging) with telemetry exported to your Datadog account.
- We will not store raw customer PII in the environment; default retention 7 days for logs — we can change per your compliance needs.

5) Next steps (actionable)
- I’ll share the POC Onramp PDF and a HubSpot deal link (attached and below).
- Please confirm by EOD Friday if the owners/timing work; Daniel, can you confirm the sample export timeline?

Attachments: Sunrise_POC_Onramp_v1.pdf, data-contract-outline.docx

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-minute sync if helpful.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0162

---
Note: Redwood will provide a short-term sandbox for the POC and an onboarding checklist once we have the signed access agreement.
